name: Modelling and Simulation of Fibrous Assemblies
description: Introduction to textile modelling and simulation, stochastic and stereological methods: random fibrous assemblies, anisotropy characteristics in fibrous structures, two and three-dimensional fibrous networks; machine learning in fibrous assemblies: artificial neural networks (ANN), convolutional neural networks (CNN), support vector machines (SVM), decision trees, reinforcement learning, applications of artificial intelligence (AI) in textiles; fuzzy logic and genetic algorithms: crisp and fuzzy sets, membership functions, fuzzification, defuzzification, optimization using genetic algorithms (GA); molecular dynamics (MD) simulation: fundamentals of MD, fibre-to-fibre interactions at the nanoscale, applications in tensile, bending, and shear behaviour prediction; curve fitting techniques: mechanical property prediction of fibrous assemblies, process-structure-property relationships; computational fluid dynamics (CFD): simulation of fluid flow, heat and mass transfer in porous fibrous materials; multiscale modelling: geometrical modelling of textile structures, integrating MD, CFD, and AI-based predictive approaches.
